Ajeernari Rasa 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Agnimandyadirogadhikar 358/235-238 
 Introduction 
 Ajeernari rasa is a classical herbal ayurvedic formulation effective in indigestion. This is a herbo-mineral formulation. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Sudha Parada (Pure form of mercury) – 46 gm 
 Sudha gandhaka (Pure form of sulphur) – 46 gm 
 Haritaki powder ( Terminalia chebula ) – 93 gm 
 Shunthi powder ( Zingiber officinale ) – 140 gm 
 Pippali powder ( Piper longum ) – 140 gm 
 Maricha powder ( Piper nigrum ) – 140 gm 
 Bhang powder ( Cannabis sativa ) – 187 gm 
 Saindhava lavana (Rock salt) – 140 gm 
 
 Description of the Ingredients Used 
 
 Shudha Parada: This pure form of mercury means purified mercury is used as a medicine. Parada is silver coloured liquid metal. Parada is a very effective drug. It balances all the three doshas (Vata, Pitta and Kapha). It has Aphrodisiac (Vrishya), Balya (Tonic), and acts as Rasayana (Rejuvenative) properties. It also enhances digestion.

 Maricha: Maricha is known as Piper nigrum . It improves the function of the digestive system. It has pungent taste and promotes digestive fire. This stimulates appetite. 
 Pippali: Pippali is known as Piper longum . It promotes digestive fire and has rejuvenating property. It pacifies Vata and Kapha. 
 Haritaki Churna: Haritaki is known as Terminalia chebula . It promotes digestion and improves strength. It is effective in indigestion, liver and spleen problems, cough, asthma etc. 
 Bhanga: This is an opium drug also known as Cannabis sativa . Bhanga is a good appetizer. It is digestant and astringent. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Prepare a kajjali (paste) by proper frolement of Shudh Parada and Shudha Gandhaka. 
 Add all the above powders in the kajjali and give 7 bhavna of nimbu swarasa (lemon extract) under the sunlight.

 Ajeernaari rasa is useful in indigestion due to low digestive fire. Trikatu and haritaki churna is best for enhancing digestive power by digesting Aama dosha (Endotoxins). Bhang is a good appetizer which increases appetite and also pacifies pain. Parada and gandhaka stimulate digestive fire and hence improves digestion. 
 Indications 
 
 Effective in indigestion 
 Act as appetizer 
 passes normal and frequent stools 
 vomiting 
  Diarrhea 
  Abdominal pain

 Cautions

 Avoid in lactating mother and pregnant women 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
